findings.label: No committed negative-path test for the preview endpoint
findings.detail: The 422 unsupported-type and access-denied cases for POST /api/v1/raw/{raw_id}/artifacts/fingerprint are only exercised by a temporary test that was removed during verification. The paths are reused verbatim from create_raw_artifacts (the artifact-type guard) and the shared _raw(...) access resolver, both tested elsewhere, so this is non-blocking. A dedicated contract or integration case would fully satisfy the stated TESTS criterion.
